pages.text: The first intermediate in estradiol production is the androgenic androstadienedione.$(br2)$(4)$(l)WARNING: touching androgens in this mod may or may not disrupt the fabric of spacetime, handle with care!

To produce androstadienedione, we need five ingredients: water, sugar, sterols, nickel sulfate, and skimmed milk powder. You should already know how to get the first three at this point.$(br2)NOTE: This mod does not add all the bacteria culturing, and this step is by far the most oversimplified of the entire mod.

Nickel sulfate can be obtained by reacting powdered nickel metal with sulfuric acid in a cauldron, then evaporating the resulting aqueous nickel sulfate solution.$(br2)To craft skimmed milk powder, spin milk in a separator, cast the skimmed milk and cream into ingots, cook them, put the cream aside for now [TODO] and
grind down the skimmed milk into dust.$(br2)$(4)$(l)WARNING: raw ingot casts are extremely unstable, handle them with care if you do not want to risk spilling milk all over your lab!

To actually brew the androstadienedione, add all of these ingredients to a fermenter having at least one mixer and heater. The brew must be stirred at all times. Follow the following temperature instructions:

Androstadienedione Recipe:$(li)Hold the temperature at around 60°C for approximately 3 real-life minutes$(li)Let the brew ferment between 25°C and 55°C for five Minecraft days.$(li)Bring the mixture up to a boil for two and a half real-life minutes.$(li)Enjoy your (highly impure and mildly carcinogenic) product!
